raw_properties.name: CommandTimeout
raw_properties.description: Número de segundos antes de que se agote el tiempo de espera de un comando. Un valor de 0 indica un tiempo de espera infinito.

raw_properties.name: OpenRowset
raw_properties.description: Especifica el nombre del objeto de base de datos usado para abrir un conjunto de filas.

raw_properties.name: OpenRowsetVariable
raw_properties.description: Especifica la variable que contiene el nombre del objeto de base de datos usado para abrir un conjunto de filas.

raw_properties.name: SqlCommand
raw_properties.description: Comando SQL para ejecutar.

raw_properties.name: DefaultCodePage
raw_properties.description: Especifica la página de códigos de columna para utilizar cuando la información de página de códigos no está disponible en el origen de datos.

raw_properties.name: AlwaysUseDefaultCodePage
raw_properties.description: Fuerza el uso del valor de la propiedad DefaultCodePage al describir datos de caracteres.

raw_properties.name: AccessMode
raw_properties.description: Especifica el modo utilizado para obtener acceso a la base de datos.

raw_properties.name: FastLoadKeepIdentity
raw_properties.description: Indica si los valores proporcionados para columnas de identidad se van a copiar al destino. Si es False, los valores de las columnas de identidad se generan automáticamente en el destino. Solo se aplica si está activada la carga rápida.

raw_properties.name: FastLoadKeepNulls
raw_properties.description: Indica si las columnas que contienen NULL tendrán NULL insertado en el destino. Si es False, las columnas que contienen NULL tendrán sus valores predeterminados insertados en el destino. Solo se aplica si está activada la carga rápida.

raw_properties.name: FastLoadOptions
raw_properties.description: Especifica opciones para usar con la carga rápida. Solo se aplica si está activada la carga rápida.

raw_properties.name: FastLoadMaxInsertCommitSize
raw_properties.description: Especifica cuándo se emiten confirmaciones durante la inserción de datos. El valor 0 especifica que se emitirá una confirmación al final de la inserción de datos. Solo se aplica si está activada la carga rápida.

    NIP,
    TIPONIF,

    COD_TIPO_CLIENTE_COMERCIAL,

    DESC_TIP_COM_RZN_INGRESA,
    COD_SEGMENTO_COMERCIAL,

    DESC_UBICACION,
    COD_CENTRO,
    DESC_CENTRO,
    COD_UBICOM,
    DESC_UBICOM,
    COD_CENTRO_UBICOM,
    DESC_CENTRO_UBICOM,
    COD_RAZON_UBICOM,
    DESC_RAZON_UBICOM,
    IDC_IND_VAL_INDICADOR_TOTAL,
    IDC_IND_DESC_ESTADO,
    IDC_EMP_VAL_INDICADOR_TOTAL,
    IDC_EMP_DESC_ESTADO,
    VAL_IND_RENTABILIDAD,
    FLA_CDNI,
    ACTIVIDAD,
    RENTABILIDAD,
    SECTOR,
    CARTERA,
    TIENEMTOPRECA,
    MTOPRECALIFICADO,
    PRECAAFECTADA,
    RANGOHABER,
    VOLNEG,
    CROSSSELLINGIND,
    PERFILIND,
    POTENCIALIND,
    CROSSSELLINGEMP,
    PERFILEMP,
    POTENCIALEMP,
    CANALPREFERENCIA,
    RECLAMOSABIERTOS,
    CODUBIPLASTICO,
    DESCUBIPLASTICO,
    FLAGMULTIUBIPLASTICO,
    PLASTICOSUDN,
    QCAMPANIAS,
    QRECIPROCIDAD,
    PORCPAGHABERES,
    CROSSSELLINGNOMINA,
    IDCNOMINA,
    CROSSSELLINGINDBPBA,
    CROSSSELLINGEMPBPBA,
    IDCINDBPBA,
    IDCEMPBPBA,
    RENTABILIDADBPBA,
    VOLNEGBPBA,
    FLA_EXCOMBATIENTE
FROM f_turneros_output_bipsuc;
raw_properties.description: The SQL command to be executed.

raw_properties.name: BlockSize
raw_properties.description: Data transfer block size.

raw_properties.name: BufferMaxSize
raw_properties.description: Maximum size of a data buffer when 'Buffer mode' is applied. Value must be large enough to hold at least one data row (including 8 overhead bytes per row at most).

raw_properties.name: BufferMode
raw_properties.description: Indicates which type of Load method is used. True stands for 'Progress Buffered Rows'. False indicates 'Progress Row By Row'.

raw_properties.name: DataEncryption
raw_properties.description: SQL requests and responses data encryption.

raw_properties.name: DefaultCodePage
raw_properties.description: The code page to use when code page information is unavailable from the data source.

raw_properties.name: DetailedTracingFile
raw_properties.description: A trace file name. Setting a value for this property enables TPT detailed tracing.

raw_properties.name: DetailedTracingLevel
raw_properties.description: Specifies the types of diagnostic messages written by each instance of the dirver to an external log file. The diagnostic trace function provides more detailed information (including the version number) in the log file to aid in problem tracking and diagnosis.

raw_properties.name: DiscardLargeRow
raw_properties.description: Whether or not to discard large rows.

raw_properties.name: ExtendedStringColumnsAllocation
raw_properties.description: Use maximal character buffers allocation factor. Used when 'Export Width Table ID' = 'Maximum Defaults'.

raw_properties.name: JobMaxRowSize
raw_properties.description: Maximum row size (kb) it can support in export. Valid values are: 64, 1024.

raw_properties.name: MaxSessions
raw_properties.description: Maximum number of sessions to log on.

raw_properties.name: MinSessions
raw_properties.description: Minimum number of sessions required.

raw_properties.name: QueryBandSessionInfo
raw_properties.description: A user-defined query band expression.

raw_properties.name: SpoolMode
raw_properties.description: Specifies whether to use spool or not while running the current Export job.

raw_properties.name: TenacityHours
raw_properties.description: The number of hours to continue trying to log on when the maximum number of load jobs is already running on the Teradata Database.

raw_properties.name: TenacitySleep
raw_properties.description: The number of minutes to pause before retrying to log on when the maximum number of load jobs is already running on the Teradata Database.

raw_properties.name: UnicodePassThrough
raw_properties.description: Whether to allow Pass Through Characters (PTCs) to be exported from Teradata.

raw_properties.name: AccessMode
raw_properties.description: The mode used to access the database.

properties.sql_command:
SELECT
    NIP,
    TIPONIF,
    NIF,
    TIPODOCUMENTO,
    NUMERODOCUMENTO,
    DENOMINACION,
    CAST(CAST(FECHANACIMIENTO AS DATE FORMAT 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS CHAR(10)
    ) AS FECHANACIMIENTO_TXT,
    COD_TIPO_CLIENTE_COMERCIAL,
    DESC_TIPO_CLIENTE_COMERCIAL,
    COD_TIP_COM_RZN_INGRESA,
    DESC_TIP_COM_RZN_INGRESA,
    COD_SEGMENTO_COMERCIAL,
    DESC_SEGMENTO_COMERCIAL,
    COD_UBICACION,
    DESC_UBICACION,
    COD_CENTRO,
    DESC_CENTRO,
    COD_UBICOM,
    DESC_UBICOM,
    COD_CENTRO_UBICOM,
    DESC_CENTRO_UBICOM,
    COD_RAZON_UBICOM,
    DESC_RAZON_UBICOM,
    IDC_IND_VAL_INDICADOR_TOTAL,
    IDC_IND_DESC_ESTADO,
    IDC_EMP_VAL_INDICADOR_TOTAL,
    IDC_EMP_DESC_ESTADO,
    VAL_IND_RENTABILIDAD,
    FLA_CDNI,
    ACTIVIDAD,
    RENTABILIDAD,
    SECTOR,
    CARTERA,
    TIENEMTOPRECA,
    MTOPRECALIFICADO,
    PRECAAFECTADA,
    RANGOHABER,
    VOLNEG,
    CROSSSELLINGIND,
    PERFILIND,
    POTENCIALIND,
    CROSSSELLINGEMP,
    PERFILEMP,
    POTENCIALEMP,
    CANALPREFERENCIA,
    RECLAMOSABIERTOS,
    CODUBIPLASTICO,
    DESCUBIPLASTICO,
    FLAGMULTIUBIPLASTICO,
    PLASTICOSUDN,
    QCAMPANIAS,
    QRECIPROCIDAD,
    PORCPAGHABERES,
    CROSSSELLINGNOMINA,
    IDCNOMINA,
    CROSSSELLINGINDBPBA,
    CROSSSELLINGEMPBPBA,
    IDCINDBPBA,
    IDCEMPBPBA,
    RENTABILIDADBPBA,
    VOLNEGBPBA,
    FLA_EXCOMBATIENTE
FROM f_turneros_output_bipsuc;

raw_properties.name: BlockSize
raw_properties.description: Data transfer block size.

raw_properties.name: BufferMaxSize
raw_properties.description: Maximum size of a data buffer when 'Buffer mode' is applied. Value must be large enough to hold at least one data row (including 8 overhead bytes per row at most).

raw_properties.name: BufferMode
raw_properties.description: Indicates which type of Load method is used. True stands for 'Progress Buffered Rows'. False indicates 'Progress Row By Row'.

raw_properties.name: DataEncryption
raw_properties.description: SQL requests and responses data encryption.

raw_properties.name: DefaultCodePage
raw_properties.description: The code page to use when code page information is unavailable from the data source.

raw_properties.name: DetailedTracingFile
raw_properties.description: A trace file name. Setting a value for this property enables TPT detailed tracing.

raw_properties.name: DetailedTracingLevel
raw_properties.description: Specifies the types of diagnostic messages written by each instance of the dirver to an external log file. The diagnostic trace function provides more detailed information (including the version number) in the log file to aid in problem tracking and diagnosis.

raw_properties.name: DiscardLargeRow
raw_properties.description: Whether or not to discard large rows.

raw_properties.name: ExtendedStringColumnsAllocation
raw_properties.description: Use maximal character buffers allocation factor. Used when 'Export Width Table ID' = 'Maximum Defaults'.

raw_properties.name: JobMaxRowSize
raw_properties.description: Maximum row size (kb) it can support in export. Valid values are: 64, 1024.

raw_properties.name: MaxSessions
raw_properties.description: Maximum number of sessions to log on.

raw_properties.name: MinSessions
raw_properties.description: Minimum number of sessions required.

raw_properties.name: QueryBandSessionInfo
raw_properties.description: A user-defined query band expression.

raw_properties.name: SpoolMode
raw_properties.description: Specifies whether to use spool or not while running the current Export job.

raw_properties.name: TenacityHours
raw_properties.description: The number of hours to continue trying to log on when the maximum number of load jobs is already running on the Teradata Database.

raw_properties.name: TenacitySleep
raw_properties.description: The number of minutes to pause before retrying to log on when the maximum number of load jobs is already running on the Teradata Database.

raw_properties.name: UnicodePassThrough
raw_properties.description: Whether to allow Pass Through Characters (PTCs) to be exported from Teradata.

raw_properties.name: AccessMode
raw_properties.description: The mode used to access the database.

SELECT
    NIP,
    TIPONIF,
    NIF,

    COD_CENTRO,
    DESC_CENTRO,
    COD_UBICOM,
    DESC_UBICOM,
    COD_CENTRO_UBICOM,

    COD_RAZON_UBICOM,

    IDC_IND_VAL_INDICADOR_TOTAL,
    IDC_IND_DESC_ESTADO,
    IDC_EMP_VAL_INDICADOR_TOTAL,
    IDC_EMP_DESC_ESTADO,
    VAL_IND_RENTABILIDAD,
    FLA_CDNI,
    ACTIVIDAD,
    RENTABILIDAD,
    SECTOR,
    CARTERA,
    TIENEMTOPRECA,
    MTOPRECALIFICADO,
    PRECAAFECTADA,
    RANGOHABER,
    VOLNEG,
    CROSSSELLINGIND,
    PERFILIND,
    POTENCIALIND,
    CROSSSELLINGEMP,
    PERFILEMP,
    POTENCIALEMP,
    CANALPREFERENCIA,
    RECLAMOSABIERTOS,
    CODUBIPLASTICO,
    DESCUBIPLASTICO,
    FLAGMULTIUBIPLASTICO,
    PLASTICOSUDN,
    QCAMPANIAS,
    QRECIPROCIDAD,
    PORCPAGHABERES,
    CROSSSELLINGNOMINA,
    IDCNOMINA,
    CROSSSELLINGINDBPBA,
    CROSSSELLINGEMPBPBA,
    IDCINDBPBA,
    IDCEMPBPBA,
    RENTABILIDADBPBA,
    VOLNEGBPBA,
    FLA_EXCOMBATIENTE
FROM f_turneros_output_bipsuc
ORDER BY NIP;

connections.ref_id: Package\Tarea Flujo Staging\Destino de OLE DB.Connections[OleDbConnection]
connections.name: OleDbConnection
connections.description: La conexión de tiempo de ejecución OLE DB usada para obtener acceso a la base de datos.

raw_properties.name: CommandTimeout
raw_properties.description: Número de segundos antes de que se agote el tiempo de espera de un comando. Un valor de 0 indica un tiempo de espera infinito.

raw_properties.name: OpenRowset
raw_properties.description: Especifica el nombre del objeto de base de datos usado para abrir un conjunto de filas.

raw_properties.name: OpenRowsetVariable
raw_properties.description: Especifica la variable que contiene el nombre del objeto de base de datos usado para abrir un conjunto de filas.

raw_properties.name: SqlCommand
raw_properties.description: Comando SQL para ejecutar.

raw_properties.name: DefaultCodePage
raw_properties.description: Especifica la página de códigos de columna para utilizar cuando la información de página de códigos no está disponible en el origen de datos.

raw_properties.name: AlwaysUseDefaultCodePage
raw_properties.description: Fuerza el uso del valor de la propiedad DefaultCodePage al describir datos de caracteres.

raw_properties.name: AccessMode
raw_properties.description: Especifica el modo utilizado para obtener acceso a la base de datos.

raw_properties.name: FastLoadKeepIdentity
raw_properties.description: Indica si los valores proporcionados para columnas de identidad se van a copiar al destino. Si es False, los valores de las columnas de identidad se generan automáticamente en el destino. Solo se aplica si está activada la carga rápida.

raw_properties.name: FastLoadKeepNulls
raw_properties.description: Indica si las columnas que contienen NULL tendrán NULL insertado en el destino. Si es False, las columnas que contienen NULL tendrán sus valores predeterminados insertados en el destino. Solo se aplica si está activada la carga rápida.

raw_properties.name: FastLoadOptions
raw_properties.description: Especifica opciones para usar con la carga rápida. Solo se aplica si está activada la carga rápida.

raw_properties.name: FastLoadMaxInsertCommitSize
raw_properties.description: Especifica cuándo se emiten confirmaciones durante la inserción de datos. El valor 0 especifica que se emitirá una confirmación al final de la inserción de datos. Solo se aplica si está activada la carga rápida.

    IDC_IND_VAL_INDICADOR_TOTAL,
    IDC_IND_DESC_ESTADO,
    IDC_EMP_VAL_INDICADOR_TOTAL,
    IDC_EMP_DESC_ESTADO,
    VAL_IND_RENTABILIDAD,
    FLA_CDNI,
    ACTIVIDAD,
    RENTABILIDAD,
    SECTOR,
    CARTERA,
    TIENEMTOPRECA,
    MTOPRECALIFICADO,
    PRECAAFECTADA,
    RANGOHABER,
    VOLNEG,
    CROSSSELLINGIND,
    PERFILIND,
    POTENCIALIND,
    CROSSSELLINGEMP,
    PERFILEMP,
    POTENCIALEMP,
    CANALPREFERENCIA,
    RECLAMOSABIERTOS,
    CODUBIPLASTICO,
    DESCUBIPLASTICO,
    FLAGMULTIUBIPLASTICO,
    PLASTICOSUDN,
    QCAMPANIAS,
    QRECIPROCIDAD,
    PORCPAGHABERES,
    CROSSSELLINGNOMINA,
    IDCNOMINA,
    CROSSSELLINGINDBPBA,
    CROSSSELLINGEMPBPBA,
    IDCINDBPBA,
    IDCEMPBPBA,

    VOLNEGBPBA,

FROM f_turneros_output_bipsuc;
raw_properties.description: The SQL command to be executed.

raw_properties.name: BlockSize
raw_properties.description: Data transfer block size.

raw_properties.name: BufferMaxSize
raw_properties.description: Maximum size of a data buffer when 'Buffer mode' is applied. Value must be large enough to hold at least one data row (including 8 overhead bytes per row at most).

raw_properties.name: BufferMode
raw_properties.description: Indicates which type of Load method is used. True stands for 'Progress Buffered Rows'. False indicates 'Progress Row By Row'.

raw_properties.name: DataEncryption
raw_properties.description: SQL requests and responses data encryption.

raw_properties.name: DefaultCodePage
raw_properties.description: The code page to use when code page information is unavailable from the data source.

raw_properties.name: DetailedTracingFile
raw_properties.description: A trace file name. Setting a value for this property enables TPT detailed tracing.

raw_properties.name: DetailedTracingLevel
raw_properties.description: Specifies the types of diagnostic messages written by each instance of the dirver to an external log file. The diagnostic trace function provides more detailed information (including the version number) in the log file to aid in problem tracking and diagnosis.

raw_properties.name: DiscardLargeRow
raw_properties.description: Whether or not to discard large rows.

raw_properties.name: ExtendedStringColumnsAllocation
raw_properties.description: Use maximal character buffers allocation factor. Used when 'Export Width Table ID' = 'Maximum Defaults'.

raw_properties.name: JobMaxRowSize
raw_properties.description: Maximum row size (kb) it can support in export. Valid values are: 64, 1024.

raw_properties.name: MaxSessions
raw_properties.description: Maximum number of sessions to log on.

raw_properties.name: MinSessions
raw_properties.description: Minimum number of sessions required.

raw_properties.name: QueryBandSessionInfo
raw_properties.description: A user-defined query band expression.

raw_properties.name: SpoolMode
raw_properties.description: Specifies whether to use spool or not while running the current Export job.

raw_properties.name: TenacityHours
raw_properties.description: The number of hours to continue trying to log on when the maximum number of load jobs is already running on the Teradata Database.

raw_properties.name: TenacitySleep
raw_properties.description: The number of minutes to pause before retrying to log on when the maximum number of load jobs is already running on the Teradata Database.

raw_properties.name: UnicodePassThrough
raw_properties.description: Whether to allow Pass Through Characters (PTCs) to be exported from Teradata.

raw_properties.name: AccessMode
raw_properties.description: The mode used to access the database.

properties.sql_command:
SELECT
    NIP,
    TIPONIF,
    NIF,
    TIPODOCUMENTO,
    NUMERODOCUMENTO,
    DENOMINACION,
    CAST(CAST(FECHANACIMIENTO AS DATE FORMAT 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS CHAR(10)
    ) AS FECHANACIMIENTO_TXT,
    COD_TIPO_CLIENTE_COMERCIAL,
    DESC_TIPO_CLIENTE_COMERCIAL,
    COD_TIP_COM_RZN_INGRESA,
    DESC_TIP_COM_RZN_INGRESA,
    COD_SEGMENTO_COMERCIAL,
    DESC_SEGMENTO_COMERCIAL,
    COD_UBICACION,
    DESC_UBICACION,
    COD_CENTRO,
    DESC_CENTRO,
    COD_UBICOM,
    DESC_UBICOM,
    COD_CENTRO_UBICOM,
    DESC_CENTRO_UBICOM,
    COD_RAZON_UBICOM,
    DESC_RAZON_UBICOM,
    IDC_IND_VAL_INDICADOR_TOTAL,
    IDC_IND_DESC_ESTADO,
    IDC_EMP_VAL_INDICADOR_TOTAL,
    IDC_EMP_DESC_ESTADO,
    VAL_IND_RENTABILIDAD,
    FLA_CDNI,
    ACTIVIDAD,
    RENTABILIDAD,
    SECTOR,
    CARTERA,
    TIENEMTOPRECA,
    MTOPRECALIFICADO,
    PRECAAFECTADA,
    RANGOHABER,
    VOLNEG,
    CROSSSELLINGIND,
    PERFILIND,
    POTENCIALIND,
    CROSSSELLINGEMP,
    PERFILEMP,
    POTENCIALEMP,
    CANALPREFERENCIA,
    RECLAMOSABIERTOS,
    CODUBIPLASTICO,
    DESCUBIPLASTICO,
    FLAGMULTIUBIPLASTICO,
    PLASTICOSUDN,
    QCAMPANIAS,
    QRECIPROCIDAD,
    PORCPAGHABERES,
    CROSSSELLINGNOMINA,
    IDCNOMINA,
    CROSSSELLINGINDBPBA,
    CROSSSELLINGEMPBPBA,
    IDCINDBPBA,
    IDCEMPBPBA,
    RENTABILIDADBPBA,
    VOLNEGBPBA,
    FLA_EXCOMBATIENTE
FROM f_turneros_output_bipsuc;

raw_properties.name: AlwaysUseDefaultCodePage
raw_properties.description: Fuerza el uso del valor de la propiedad DefaultCodePage al describir datos de caracteres.

raw_properties.name: AccessMode
raw_properties.description: Especifica el modo utilizado para obtener acceso a la base de datos.

raw_properties.name: FastLoadKeepIdentity
raw_properties.description: Indica si los valores proporcionados para columnas de identidad se van a copiar al destino. Si es False, los valores de las columnas de identidad se generan automáticamente en el destino. Solo se aplica si está activada la carga rápida.

raw_properties.name: FastLoadKeepNulls
raw_properties.description: Indica si las columnas que contienen NULL tendrán NULL insertado en el destino. Si es False, las columnas que contienen NULL tendrán sus valores predeterminados insertados en el destino. Solo se aplica si está activada la carga rápida.

raw_properties.name: FastLoadOptions
raw_properties.description: Especifica opciones para usar con la carga rápida. Solo se aplica si está activada la carga rápida.

raw_properties.name: FastLoadMaxInsertCommitSize
raw_properties.description: Especifica cuándo se emiten confirmaciones durante la inserción de datos. El valor 0 especifica que se emitirá una confirmación al final de la inserción de datos. Solo se aplica si está activada la carga rápida.

raw_properties.description: The SQL command to be executed.

raw_properties.name: BlockSize
raw_properties.description: Data transfer block size.

raw_properties.name: BufferMaxSize
raw_properties.description: Maximum size of a data buffer when 'Buffer mode' is applied. Value must be large enough to hold at least one data row (including 8 overhead bytes per row at most).

raw_properties.name: BufferMode
raw_properties.description: Indicates which type of Load method is used. True stands for 'Progress Buffered Rows'. False indicates 'Progress Row By Row'.

raw_properties.name: DataEncryption
raw_properties.description: SQL requests and responses data encryption.

raw_properties.name: DefaultCodePage
raw_properties.description: The code page to use when code page information is unavailable from the data source.

raw_properties.name: DetailedTracingFile
raw_properties.description: A trace file name. Setting a value for this property enables TPT detailed tracing.

raw_properties.name: DetailedTracingLevel
raw_properties.description: Specifies the types of diagnostic messages written by each instance of the dirver to an external log file. The diagnostic trace function provides more detailed information (including the version number) in the log file to aid in problem tracking and diagnosis.

raw_properties.name: DiscardLargeRow
raw_properties.description: Whether or not to discard large rows.

raw_properties.name: ExtendedStringColumnsAllocation
raw_properties.description: Use maximal character buffers allocation factor. Used when 'Export Width Table ID' = 'Maximum Defaults'.

raw_properties.name: JobMaxRowSize
raw_properties.description: Maximum row size (kb) it can support in export. Valid values are: 64, 1024.

raw_properties.name: MaxSessions
raw_properties.description: Maximum number of sessions to log on.

raw_properties.name: MinSessions
raw_properties.description: Minimum number of sessions required.

raw_properties.name: QueryBandSessionInfo
raw_properties.description: A user-defined query band expression.

raw_properties.name: SpoolMode
raw_properties.description: Specifies whether to use spool or not while running the current Export job.

raw_properties.name: TenacityHours
raw_properties.description: The number of hours to continue trying to log on when the maximum number of load jobs is already running on the Teradata Database.

raw_properties.name: TenacitySleep
raw_properties.description: The number of minutes to pause before retrying to log on when the maximum number of load jobs is already running on the Teradata Database.

raw_properties.name: UnicodePassThrough
raw_properties.description: Whether to allow Pass Through Characters (PTCs) to be exported from Teradata.

raw_properties.name: AccessMode
raw_properties.description: The mode used to access the database.

SELECT
    NIP,
    TIPONIF,
    NIF,
    TIPODOCUMENTO,
    NUMERODOCUMENTO,
    DENOMINACION,
    CAST(CAST(FECHANACIMIENTO AS DATE FORMAT 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS CHAR(10)
    ) AS FECHANACIMIENTO_TXT,
    COD_TIPO_CLIENTE_COMERCIAL,
    DESC_TIPO_CLIENTE_COMERCIAL,
    COD_TIP_COM_RZN_INGRESA,
    DESC_TIP_COM_RZN_INGRESA,
    COD_SEGMENTO_COMERCIAL,
    DESC_SEGMENTO_COMERCIAL,
    COD_UBICACION,
    DESC_UBICACION,
    COD_CENTRO,
    DESC_CENTRO,
    COD_UBICOM,
    DESC_UBICOM,
    COD_CENTRO_UBICOM,
    DESC_CENTRO_UBICOM,
    COD_RAZON_UBICOM,
    DESC_RAZON_UBICOM,
    IDC_IND_VAL_INDICADOR_TOTAL,
    IDC_IND_DESC_ESTADO,
    IDC_EMP_VAL_INDICADOR_TOTAL,
    IDC_EMP_DESC_ESTADO,
    VAL_IND_RENTABILIDAD,
    FLA_CDNI,
    ACTIVIDAD,
    RENTABILIDAD,
    SECTOR,
    CARTERA,
    TIENEMTOPRECA,
    MTOPRECALIFICADO,
    PRECAAFECTADA,
    RANGOHABER,
    VOLNEG,
    CROSSSELLINGIND,
    PERFILIND,
    POTENCIALIND,
    CROSSSELLINGEMP,
    PERFILEMP,
    POTENCIALEMP,
    CANALPREFERENCIA,
    RECLAMOSABIERTOS,
    CODUBIPLASTICO,
    DESCUBIPLASTICO,
    FLAGMULTIUBIPLASTICO,
    PLASTICOSUDN,
    QCAMPANIAS,
    QRECIPROCIDAD,
    PORCPAGHABERES,
    CROSSSELLINGNOMINA,
    IDCNOMINA,
    CROSSSELLINGINDBPBA,
    CROSSSELLINGEMPBPBA,
    IDCINDBPBA,
    IDCEMPBPBA,
    RENTABILIDADBPBA,
    VOLNEGBPBA,
    FLA_EXCOMBATIENTE
FROM f_turneros_output_bipsuc;

raw_properties.name: BlockSize

raw_properties.name: BufferMaxSize
raw_properties.description: Maximum size of a data buffer when 'Buffer mode' is applied. Value must be large enough to hold at least one data row (including 8 overhead bytes per row at most).

raw_properties.name: BufferMode
raw_properties.description: Indicates which type of Load method is used. True stands for 'Progress Buffered Rows'. False indicates 'Progress Row By Row'.

raw_properties.name: DataEncryption
raw_properties.description: SQL requests and responses data encryption.

raw_properties.name: DefaultCodePage
raw_properties.description: The code page to use when code page information is unavailable from the data source.

raw_properties.name: DetailedTracingFile
raw_properties.description: A trace file name. Setting a value for this property enables TPT detailed tracing.

raw_properties.name: DetailedTracingLevel
raw_properties.description: Specifies the types of diagnostic messages written by each instance of the dirver to an external log file. The diagnostic trace function provides more detailed information (including the version number) in the log file to aid in problem tracking and diagnosis.

raw_properties.name: DiscardLargeRow
raw_properties.description: Whether or not to discard large rows.

raw_properties.name: ExtendedStringColumnsAllocation
raw_properties.description: Use maximal character buffers allocation factor. Used when 'Export Width Table ID' = 'Maximum Defaults'.

raw_properties.name: JobMaxRowSize
raw_properties.description: Maximum row size (kb) it can support in export. Valid values are: 64, 1024.

raw_properties.name: MaxSessions
raw_properties.description: Maximum number of sessions to log on.

raw_properties.name: MinSessions
raw_properties.description: Minimum number of sessions required.

raw_properties.name: QueryBandSessionInfo
raw_properties.description: A user-defined query band expression.

raw_properties.name: SpoolMode
raw_properties.description: Specifies whether to use spool or not while running the current Export job.

raw_properties.name: TenacityHours
raw_properties.description: The number of hours to continue trying to log on when the maximum number of load jobs is already running on the Teradata Database.

raw_properties.name: TenacitySleep
raw_properties.description: The number of minutes to pause before retrying to log on when the maximum number of load jobs is already running on the Teradata Database.

raw_properties.name: UnicodePassThrough
raw_properties.description: Whether to allow Pass Through Characters (PTCs) to be exported from Teradata.

raw_properties.description: The mode used to access the database.

SELECT
    NIP,

    COD_CENTRO,
    DESC_CENTRO,
    COD_UBICOM,
    DESC_UBICOM,
    COD_CENTRO_UBICOM,
    DESC_CENTRO_UBICOM,
    COD_RAZON_UBICOM,
    DESC_RAZON_UBICOM,
    IDC_IND_VAL_INDICADOR_TOTAL,
    IDC_IND_DESC_ESTADO,
    IDC_EMP_VAL_INDICADOR_TOTAL,
    IDC_EMP_DESC_ESTADO,
    VAL_IND_RENTABILIDAD,
    FLA_CDNI,
    ACTIVIDAD,
    RENTABILIDAD,
    SECTOR,
    CARTERA,
    TIENEMTOPRECA,
    MTOPRECALIFICADO,
    PRECAAFECTADA,
    RANGOHABER,
    VOLNEG,
    CROSSSELLINGIND,
    PERFILIND,
    POTENCIALIND,
    CROSSSELLINGEMP,
    PERFILEMP,
    POTENCIALEMP,
    CANALPREFERENCIA,
    RECLAMOSABIERTOS,
    CODUBIPLASTICO,
    DESCUBIPLASTICO,
    FLAGMULTIUBIPLASTICO,
    PLASTICOSUDN,
    QCAMPANIAS,
    QRECIPROCIDAD,
    PORCPAGHABERES,
    CROSSSELLINGNOMINA,
    IDCNOMINA,
    CROSSSELLINGINDBPBA,
    CROSSSELLINGEMPBPBA,
    IDCINDBPBA,
    IDCEMPBPBA,
    RENTABILIDADBPBA,
    VOLNEGBPBA,
    FLA_EXCOMBATIENTE
FROM f_turneros_output_bipsuc
ORDER BY NIP;

connections.ref_id: Package\Tarea Flujo Staging\Destino de OLE DB.Connections[OleDbConnection]
connections.name: OleDbConnection
connections.description: La conexión de tiempo de ejecución OLE DB usada para obtener acceso a la base de datos.

raw_properties.name: CommandTimeout
raw_properties.description: Número de segundos antes de que se agote el tiempo de espera de un comando. Un valor de 0 indica un tiempo de espera infinito.

raw_properties.name: OpenRowset
raw_properties.description: Especifica el nombre del objeto de base de datos usado para abrir un conjunto de filas.

raw_properties.name: OpenRowsetVariable
raw_properties.description: Especifica la variable que contiene el nombre del objeto de base de datos usado para abrir un conjunto de filas.

raw_properties.name: SqlCommand
raw_properties.description: Comando SQL para ejecutar.

raw_properties.name: DefaultCodePage
raw_properties.description: Especifica la página de códigos de columna para utilizar cuando la información de página de códigos no está disponible en el origen de datos.

raw_properties.name: AlwaysUseDefaultCodePage
raw_properties.description: Fuerza el uso del valor de la propiedad DefaultCodePage al describir datos de caracteres.

raw_properties.name: AccessMode
raw_properties.description: Especifica el modo utilizado para obtener acceso a la base de datos.

raw_properties.name: FastLoadKeepIdentity
raw_properties.description: Indica si los valores proporcionados para columnas de identidad se van a copiar al destino. Si es False, los valores de las columnas de identidad se generan automáticamente en el destino. Solo se aplica si está activada la carga rápida.

raw_properties.name: FastLoadKeepNulls
raw_properties.description: Indica si las columnas que contienen NULL tendrán NULL insertado en el destino. Si es False, las columnas que contienen NULL tendrán sus valores predeterminados insertados en el destino. Solo se aplica si está activada la carga rápida.

raw_properties.name: FastLoadOptions
raw_properties.description: Especifica opciones para usar con la carga rápida. Solo se aplica si está activada la carga rápida.

raw_properties.name: FastLoadMaxInsertCommitSize
raw_properties.description: Especifica cuándo se emiten confirmaciones durante la inserción de datos. El valor 0 especifica que se emitirá una confirmación al final de la inserción de datos. Solo se aplica si está activada la carga rápida.

    IDC_IND_DESC_ESTADO,

    IDC_EMP_DESC_ESTADO,
    VAL_IND_RENTABILIDAD,
    FLA_CDNI,
    ACTIVIDAD,
    RENTABILIDAD,

    CARTERA,
    TIENEMTOPRECA,
    MTOPRECALIFICADO,
    PRECAAFECTADA,

    VOLNEG,
    CROSSSELLINGIND,
    PERFILIND,
    POTENCIALIND,

    POTENCIALEMP,
    CANALPREFERENCIA,

    DESCUBIPLASTICO,
    FLAGMULTIUBIPLASTICO,
    PLASTICOSUDN,
    QCAMPANIAS,
    QRECIPROCIDAD,
    PORCPAGHABERES,
    CROSSSELLINGNOMINA,
    IDCNOMINA,
    CROSSSELLINGINDBPBA,

FROM f_turneros_output_bipsuc;
raw_properties.description: The SQL command to be executed.

raw_properties.name: BlockSize
raw_properties.description: Data transfer block size.

raw_properties.name: BufferMaxSize
raw_properties.description: Maximum size of a data buffer when 'Buffer mode' is applied. Value must be large enough to hold at least one data row (including 8 overhead bytes per row at most).

raw_properties.name: BufferMode
raw_properties.description: Indicates which type of Load method is used. True stands for 'Progress Buffered Rows'. False indicates 'Progress Row By Row'.

raw_properties.name: DataEncryption
raw_properties.description: SQL requests and responses data encryption.

raw_properties.name: DefaultCodePage
raw_properties.description: The code page to use when code page information is unavailable from the data source.

raw_properties.name: DetailedTracingFile
raw_properties.description: A trace file name. Setting a value for this property enables TPT detailed tracing.

raw_properties.name: DetailedTracingLevel
raw_properties.description: Specifies the types of diagnostic messages written by each instance of the dirver to an external log file. The diagnostic trace function provides more detailed information (including the version number) in the log file to aid in problem tracking and diagnosis.

raw_properties.name: DiscardLargeRow
raw_properties.description: Whether or not to discard large rows.

raw_properties.name: ExtendedStringColumnsAllocation
raw_properties.description: Use maximal character buffers allocation factor. Used when 'Export Width Table ID' = 'Maximum Defaults'.

raw_properties.name: JobMaxRowSize
raw_properties.description: Maximum row size (kb) it can support in export. Valid values are: 64, 1024.

raw_properties.name: MaxSessions
raw_properties.description: Maximum number of sessions to log on.

raw_properties.name: MinSessions
raw_properties.description: Minimum number of sessions required.

raw_properties.name: QueryBandSessionInfo
raw_properties.description: A user-defined query band expression.

raw_properties.name: SpoolMode
raw_properties.description: Specifies whether to use spool or not while running the current Export job.

raw_properties.name: TenacityHours
raw_properties.description: The number of hours to continue trying to log on when the maximum number of load jobs is already running on the Teradata Database.

raw_properties.name: TenacitySleep
raw_properties.description: The number of minutes to pause before retrying to log on when the maximum number of load jobs is already running on the Teradata Database.

raw_properties.name: UnicodePassThrough
raw_properties.description: Whether to allow Pass Through Characters (PTCs) to be exported from Teradata.

raw_properties.name: AccessMode
raw_properties.description: The mode used to access the database.

properties.sql_command:
SELECT
    NIP,
    TIPONIF,
    NIF,
    TIPODOCUMENTO,
    NUMERODOCUMENTO,
    DENOMINACION,
    CAST(CAST(FECHANACIMIENTO AS DATE FORMAT 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS CHAR(10)
    ) AS FECHANACIMIENTO_TXT,
    COD_TIPO_CLIENTE_COMERCIAL,
    DESC_TIPO_CLIENTE_COMERCIAL,
    COD_TIP_COM_RZN_INGRESA,
    DESC_TIP_COM_RZN_INGRESA,
    COD_SEGMENTO_COMERCIAL,
    DESC_SEGMENTO_COMERCIAL,
    COD_UBICACION,
    DESC_UBICACION,
    COD_CENTRO,
    DESC_CENTRO,
    COD_UBICOM,
    DESC_UBICOM,
    COD_CENTRO_UBICOM,
    DESC_CENTRO_UBICOM,
    COD_RAZON_UBICOM,
    DESC_RAZON_UBICOM,
    IDC_IND_VAL_INDICADOR_TOTAL,
    IDC_IND_DESC_ESTADO,
    IDC_EMP_VAL_INDICADOR_TOTAL,
    IDC_EMP_DESC_ESTADO,
    VAL_IND_RENTABILIDAD,
    FLA_CDNI,
    ACTIVIDAD,
    RENTABILIDAD,
    SECTOR,
    CARTERA,
    TIENEMTOPRECA,
    MTOPRECALIFICADO,
    PRECAAFECTADA,
    RANGOHABER,
    VOLNEG,
    CROSSSELLINGIND,
    PERFILIND,
    POTENCIALIND,
    CROSSSELLINGEMP,
    PERFILEMP,
    POTENCIALEMP,
    CANALPREFERENCIA,
    RECLAMOSABIERTOS,
    CODUBIPLASTICO,
    DESCUBIPLASTICO,
    FLAGMULTIUBIPLASTICO,
    PLASTICOSUDN,
    QCAMPANIAS,
    QRECIPROCIDAD,
    PORCPAGHABERES,
    CROSSSELLINGNOMINA,
    IDCNOMINA,
    CROSSSELLINGINDBPBA,
    CROSSSELLINGEMPBPBA,
    IDCINDBPBA,
    IDCEMPBPBA,
    RENTABILIDADBPBA,
    VOLNEGBPBA,
    FLA_EXCOMBATIENTE
FROM f_turneros_output_bipsuc;
